class.name: NetwTableHandle
class.brief_description: One replicated table holding rows and packed arrays of column data.
class.description:
Data travels as columns in one message. [NetwSchema] declares the columns and [method Netw.table] opens the table. [codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3(&"pos") static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
@onready var mobs := Netw.table(self, &"Mob") [/codeblock] There is one [NetwTableHandle] per table. Connect [signal received] once and keep the handle in a field.
A route is a session-stable row identity, a row index would be unstable because tables can add and remove rows.
[b]Writing[/b] Every column the schema declares crosses the wire in waves. [method commit] stamps the wave with the session's tick. [codeblock] func _on_tick() -> void: mobs.write_routes(routes) mobs.write_column(Mobs.pos, positions) mobs.write_column(Mobs.hp, health) mobs.commit() [/codeblock]
[b]Reading[/b] A column comes back as the packed array it was written as, in row order. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: mobs.received.connect(_on_mobs)
func _on_mobs(_tick: int) -> void: var pos: PackedVector3Array = mobs.read_column(Mobs.pos) multimesh.instance_count = pos.size() for row in pos.size(): multimesh.set_instance_transform(row, Transform3D(Basis(), pos[row])) [/codeblock] [method read_births] and [method read_deaths] name the routes the latest wave added and removed. A reader that keeps an object per row steps them from those two rather than diffing the table. [b]Saving[/b] [method save] stores the committed rows in a [NetwDatabase] under a key, and [method load] replaces the whole table with them. Routes are new in every session, so the game names each row with a stable id and pairs the ids with the routes a load hands back. In the reply [method load] settles with, the row saved as [code]ids[i][/code] now lives at [code]routes[i][/code]. [codeblock] func save_forest() -> Error: return await mobs.save(db, &"forest", mob_ids).wait()
func load_forest() -> void: var loaded: Dictionary = await mobs.load(db, &"forest").wait() if loaded.error != OK: show_load_error(loaded.error) return if loaded.found: rebuild_mob_index(loaded.ids, loaded.routes) [/codeblock]

method.name: commit
method.description: Fixes the columns as the applied state readers compare against, stamped with the session's own tick. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the wave was applied ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the session this handle names is gone ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the schema is open, a route was never written, a column was not written this wave, or a column's element count disagrees with the row ID count times its declared stride [/codeblock]

method.name: load
method.description: Replaces every row of the table with the snapshot stored under [param key] in [param database], and settles with a [Dictionary]. Each loaded row gets a new route. The table is untouched unless the whole snapshot is applied. A missing snapshot answers [code]found[/code] false, and a snapshot that does not decode against the schema answers its error. A [method commit] while the snapshot is being read makes the load answer [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY], so a load never overwrites rows written after it started. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading anything else │ ┠╴OK the snapshot was applied, or none is stored │ ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer holds no session authority │ ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the table and the database belong to different │ │ sessions, or the table's schema is not sealed │ ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER key is empty │ ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open │ ┠╴ERR_BUSY a commit landed while the snapshot was read, or the │ │ database is full │ ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED the snapshot is not in this library's format, or │ │ carries a newer storage version than the schema │ ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the snapshot does not match the schema │ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE session authority moved or the database closed while │ │ the snapshot was read │ ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read the snapshot ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┠╴found bool whether a snapshot was stored under the key ┠╴ids PackedStringArray the id each loaded row was saved under ┖╴routes PackedInt64Array the route each loaded row now lives at [/codeblock] Routes an earlier load handed out are released once no other table holds them. Routes the game wrote itself are never released by a load. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: of
method.description: The table declared under [param name] in [member Node.multiplayer].

method.name: row_of
method.description: The row holding [param route], or [code]-1[/code] when it is absent.

method.name: rows_of
method.description: The row for each entry in [param routes], preserving input order and returning [code]-1[/code] for each absent route.

method.name: read_births
method.description: The routes added by the latest admitted wave. See [method read_routes] for the order of elements.

method.name: read_column
method.description: The packed values stored in [param column]. See [NetwSchema] for the column's storage type and stride.

method.name: read_deaths
method.description: The routes removed by the latest admitted wave.

method.name: read_routes
method.description: The routes stored in this table, in row order.

method.name: save
method.description: Stores the committed rows as one snapshot under [param key] in [param database], and settles with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [param ids] names each row in the order of [method read_routes]. The rows are copied before this returns, so a later [method commit] does not change what is written. A snapshot of zero rows is stored, and loading it empties the table. Values are stored at full precision whatever the column's wire quantizer. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the snapshot was stored ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer holds no session authority ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA an id is empty or repeated, the ids and rows disagree in │ count, or the connection answered no outcome ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER the key is empty, or the schema has a COLUMN_ENTITY column ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the table and the database belong to different sessions, │ or the table's schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 unsettled operations ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the connection implements no _write_batch, or the │ database closed before the snapshot settled ┖╴backend-defined the backend refused or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: write_column
method.description: Stages [param data] for [param column]. A column is addressed by the index its [NetwSchema] declaration returned. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the column was staged ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the session this handle names is gone ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the schema is not sealed yet ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA column is out of range, or data's storage type does not match the declared column [/codeblock]

method.name: write_routes
method.description: Stages [param routes] as this table's row identity column. Its size is how many elements every other staged column owes.

members.member: Whether the session this handle names is still alive. A handle outliving its session answers every other member empty and every verb [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].
Whether this table's frames are sent reliably. Leave it [code]false[/code] for state that the next wave replaces anyway, and set it for a table whose rows a peer cannot afford to miss.
The name this table was declared under, which is the name [method Netw.table] takes.
The session's handle for this table.
The tick carried by the latest committed wave, or [code]-1[/code] before the first commit.
The sealed schema hash this table carries on the wire. Two peers that bound different sets of tables number them differently, and this is what catches that.

signal.name: received
signal.description: Emitted once for each wave this table produced or an arriving frame touched. [param tick] is the one the commit stamped, so several commits inside one tick collapse to the last.
